description: Packages whose origin is unknown (provenance/origins.json p28_status 'unknown') and that the dependency gate may still allow. Every entry needs a reason, a reviewer and a date; entries not signed by the principal are reported as warnings (and fail with --strict).

entries.name: filetype
entries.reason: Transitive (langchain-google-genai), not imported on Locus code paths; pure-Python file-type sniffing by Tomas Aparicio, whose profile says 'Decentralized'. Allowed at the resolved version until origin evidence is recorded or a D-29 inspection is run.

entries.name: httpx
entries.reason: Core HTTP client (backend, model client tests, OTLP export). BSD-3-Clause, maintained by Encode / Tom Christie; no public location for the organization or the author. No indicator of a P28-listed origin; allowed until origin evidence (e.g. the maintaining company's registration) is recorded or a D-29 inspection is run.

entries.name: presidio-analyzer
entries.reason: PII detection behind the DLP filter. Created by Microsoft (the microsoft/presidio repository redirects to data-privacy-stack/presidio); the current organization's location and ownership were not established. Allowed until that is recorded or a D-29 inspection is run.

entries.name: psycopg
entries.reason: PostgreSQL driver (LGPL-3.0), maintained by Daniele Varrazzo / The Psycopg Team for many years; no location on the public profiles. Allowed until origin evidence is recorded or a D-29 inspection is run.
